title: Dissection and Immunohistochemistry of Mouse Vagal Ganglia
author: Thomas Taylor-Clark
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baumieu6
materials: Tissue were incubated primary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer overnight at 4 °C. Set 1. Rabbit anti-TrkA (1:300, 06-574, Millipore) and Goat anti-VR1 (1:150, SC-12498, Santa Cruz) Set 2. Rabbit anti-TrkA (1:300, 06-574, Millipore) and Goat anti-TrkB (1:300, AF1494, R&D Systems)

Secondary antibodies were diluted in the 1% bovine serum albumin/5% normal donkey serum/0.2% PBST and tissue were incubated with it for 1 hour at room temperature. 1. Alexa Fluor 488 donkey anti-rabbit (1:300, A21206, Invitrogen) 2. Alexa Fluor 647 Chicken anti-Goat (1:300, A21469, Invitrogen)

Tissue were incubated primary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer overnight at 4 °C. Set 1. Rabbit anti-TrkA (1:300, 06-574, Millipore) and Goat anti-VR1 (1:150, SC-12498, Santa Cruz) Set 2. Rabbit anti-TrkA (1:300, 06-574, Millipore) and Goat anti-TrkB (1:300, AF1494, R&D Systems)

steps.title: Euthanize mice
steps.instruction: Euthanize 6‑ to 8‑week‑old male mice by CO₂ inhalation.

steps.title: Perfuse mice
steps.instruction: Transcardially perfuse each mouse with phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) to remove blood, followed by 3.7 % formaldehyde (PFA) in PBS.

steps.title: Dissect and fix ganglia
steps.instruction: Collect vagal ganglia (both jugular and nodose) and fix them in 3.7 % PFA for 2 hours on ice.

steps.title: Cryoprotect ganglia
steps.instruction: Transfer the fixed ganglia to 18 % sucrose solution and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Embed and freeze tissue
steps.instruction: Mount the ganglia in optimal cutting temperature (OCT) compound and freeze.

steps.title: Section tissue
steps.instruction: Cut frozen tissue at 20 µm thickness and collect sections onto Superfrost Plus microscopy slides.

steps.title: Wash sections with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the sections with PBS three times, 10 min each.

steps.title: Block sections
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in blocking buffer (1 % bovine serum albumin, 10 % normal donkey serum, 0.3 % Triton X‑100 in PBS) for 45 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash sections with PBST
steps.instruction: Wash the sections with 0.2 % Tween‑20 in PBS (PBST) three times, 10 min each at room temperature.

steps.title: Mount and dry slides
steps.instruction: Cover‑slip the sections with DPX for imaging and let dry in the dark overnight.
